title: Solvent-modulated second harmonic generation in N-alkylated thiohydantoin derivatives: synthesis, characterization, and first-principle insights
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37325-37347
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06169E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Muhammad Arif Ali, Muhammad Zahid Qureshi, Rahman Shah Zaib Saleem, Mariusz Mojzych, Ahsan Sharif, Muhammad Arshad
This study explores the synthesis of five new thiohydantoin derivatives from MAS1 to MAS5, spectroscopic characterization, and optoelectronic properties of thiohydantoin derivatives using a combined experimental and computational approach.
